name: Shimotsuki Miina
source:
Cousin of the main character and daughter of Eriko.  She is a natural girl who is a bit mysterious. She has a strong sense of curiosity. 

She has never had much interest in sex, so she doesn't have much sexual knowledge.

[From [url=http://www.r18game.com/tougenkyo/taiken/chara.html]official site[/url]]
